govt_response.summary: The Ministry of Education presents the rise in higher-education enrolment and GER as progress, while the specific 30 per cent target for 2020 was not reached.

analysis:
Sibal said in Pulwama on 23 October 2012 that he had set a target of 30 per cent enrolment in higher education by the end of 2020, up from about 19 per cent at the time.

AISHE 2020-21 reported a GER of 27.3 per cent for the 18-23 age group. A subsequent Rajya Sabha answer gave 28.4 per cent for 2021-22 and 29.5 per cent for 2022-23 (provisional). The 30 per cent target was therefore not reached by the end of 2020.

The government describes the increase from 25.2 per cent in 2016-17 to 27.3 per cent in 2020-21 as progress, but the specific 2020 deadline was missed.
notes: The AISHE final report PDF is a mirror of the official report; the PIB release and the Rajya Sabha answer carry the same GER series. The target applied to higher education generally, not only to universities. [ingest: 1 evidence link(s) blocked/unreachable to the checker; verify manually]
